services.desc: Rates Tracy Arm Fjord - $3,600.00 - The price is for 1-6 Passengers About The prices for these trips are for the boat, not per person. "Tracy Arm" is a magnificent sights and truly a once in a lifetime adventure. The scenery and wildlife viewing are simply amazing. ​ On these trips your party will see a wide variety of wildlife: Humpback Whales, Killer Whales, Steller Sea lions, Pacific Harbor Seals, Otters, Dall's Porpoises, Sitka Black-tailed deer, Black or Brown bears, Mountain Goats and multiple different birds. ​ A meal will be provided for 8 hour trips along with snacks and drinks (Non-Alcoholic beverages) on these adventure if requested. services.name: 3 hour Halibut fishing - Catch and Release & Whale watching!
services.desc: New Federal regulations have dramaticly changed Charter Halibut fishing. They have limited the amount of Halibut retention trips per day to 1trip per boat and per Halibut permit. We are offer Catch and release trips which will save you money on a few levels. 1st - The cost of the trips. 2nd - Cost of Processing the retained Halibut. With the Catch and Release trips we have vendors who can, if you want, purchase Halibut and send it home. Yes, its not the Halibut you caught. However it is freshly Commercially caught and processed.
